notes: The release asset is a wrapper: a ZIP whose single entry is the installable extension ZIP. Blender cannot install the wrapper directly, so fetch_cats.py unwraps it.
Verified on 2026-08-06 against Material Combiner 3.1.0: the CATS integration, restart, and uninstall checkpoint all pass with this build.
Hash drift is reported as a warning, not a failure, because the CATS repository has not yet adopted the same release automation. Set HASH_MISMATCH_IS_FATAL in tools/fetch_cats.py to make it blocking.
